summary: Frontend-only regression of redesigned Dashboard stat cards (.stat-grid/.stat) and quick actions (.qa-grid/.qa). All requested checks passed: mock login with empty fields shows dashboard-skeleton then dashboard-page; stat-ytd-spend shows 'YTD spend' with final count-up value $4,563.00, 9 bars (spend-bar-jan..sep), axis JAN/MAY/SEP, meta 'Year progress 69%' and 'Open amount $51 · 3 orders'; hovering spend-bar-apr shows fully-visible tooltip 'Apr · $1,692.00' (bbox width=101, not clipped); spend-range-toggle switches to 'Trailing 12-month spend' with $5,973.00, button label 'Last 12 months', 12 bars, axis OCT/APR/SEP and toggles back. stat-balance shows 'Outstanding balance' $51.00 with chip 'No past-due balance' and meta Past due $0.00 / Current balance $51.00. stat-terms shows '50% Prepay, 50% Net 60' with chip 'Invoiced account' and meta 'Active orders 3 open' + 'Last order placed Sep 2 · 7d ago' (bold value, muted suffix span.muted confirmed in DOM). All 4 quick-action cards navigate to the correct placeholder-page and sidebar active updates (Marketplace/Pre-Book/My Orders/Resources); clicking Dashboard sidebar item returns. Recent Orders regression works: 3 default rows, orders-scope-all shows 8, clicking order-row-SO56680 opens order-drawer, order-drawer-close closes it. No console errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: Sidebar nav items in App.tsx lack data-testid attributes (e.g., sidebar-dashboard, sidebar-marketplace). Tests currently rely on visible text — adding data-testid would harden automation.
test_credentials: Mock auth: click login-submit-btn with empty fields (demo). Or ryan@goorin.com / password123.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dashboard redesign verified. Sidebar nav items don't have data-testid; use .sidebar .nav-item with has_text filter to click nav entries. useCountUp animation takes ~900ms — wait ~1.2s before asserting final stat values.
